name: Pixora Product Magnifier for WooCommerce
author: Umer Zaki

sections.description:
Pixora Product Magnifier for WooCommerce adds a circular magnifier to WooCommerce product images. It works with classic WooCommerce product galleries and supports the modern WooCommerce Product Gallery block.

The plugin is lightweight, does not add an admin settings page, and does not store personal data.

Features

  • Product image magnifier on desktop.
  • Touch magnifier support on mobile devices.
  • Supports classic WooCommerce product galleries.
  • Supports the WooCommerce Product Gallery block.
  • Uses the full-size product image for magnification.
  • No external JavaScript or CSS libraries.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Open a WooCommerce product page and hover or touch the product image.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required.

Does the plugin store personal data?

No. The plugin does not collect or store personal data.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. Touch interaction is supported on mobile devices.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Updated plugin structure and WordPress coding practices.
  • Added support for current WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
  • Added classic WooCommerce gallery compatibility.
  • Added support for the WooCommerce Product Gallery block.
  • Improved escaping, asset loading, and dynamic gallery handling.
  • Removed hardcoded plugin paths and global script deregistration.
